question.text: Within how many working days of the Board meeting must a company obtain stock exchange approval for a bonus issue?

explanation.text: The Logic: A company must obtain stock exchange approval for a bonus issue within 5 working days of the Board meeting at which the bonus was approved. This tight timeline ensures the market is informed promptly and that the issuance process proceeds without undue delay. The Trap: 3, 7, and 10 working days are plausible round numbers that mirror unrelated SEBI timelines. Only 5 working days matches the bonus-issue rule. Note: Each corporate action has its own statutory and SEBI-driven timeline — bonus-issue approval is specifically pegged at 5 working days from the Board meeting.
